# T2 Kitchen

Status: Draft for product-owner review (b10-design §7.2 item 1). Not delivered at any venue.

- Audience: Kitchen staff (Back of house)
- Runs it: VM
- Length: 15 minutes in the shift ([walkthrough](README.md#walkthrough))
- Practical task: Photograph one dish and label it.

## Covers

- Photographing a dish from Our menu
- Labels and variants
- Several photos of one dish
- Better photo requested
- The optional photo tips

- [Our menu](../../usage-staff.md#our-menu)

## Photo tips (optional, from the photo guide)

- Tandoor and grilled dishes: Start with a 45° view of the whole plated item. If another photo adds useful detail, show the surface or a side view. Keep any accompaniments included in the serving visible.
- Bread: Show the whole serving from above. An optional closer view can show its texture. Photograph it as it is normally served.
- Only take photos when it's safe. Never while carrying hot food or using a knife.

## Not covered

- Ingredients, allergens, sizes or availability: not part of photo capture and never claimed in training.
